description.en: Tells whether a child scene (menu, movie or HQ event started with CMND_MAKE_CHILD_MENU_SCENE, CMND_MAKE_CHILD_MOVIE_SCENE or CMND_MAKE_CHILD_HQ_EVENT_SCENE) is still running: it reads the script system's child-scene flag.

true while a child scene runs, false otherwise.
null if the script system is not ready.

examples.case: Waiting for a menu to close (real usage, from ev42022000.nut)
